name: p2r8-daily-risk-smoke
user_decisions_2026_09_18: risk-check frequency daily (upgraded from weekly by user); event-driven is supplement only; half-day cross-section and >10-day holding approved and queued; 20% drawdown budget stays a hard constraint

inherits_from.resolution_rule: runner verifies this sha256 before loading (fail-closed); inherits VERBATIM: u1_whitelist_frozen (1,168 codes), universe (U2/U3/U4/U5), preflight, fees, sizing base rule, execution_semantics base (entry/exit/slot_busy/limit_proxy/t_plus/forced_delist/slot_accounting), warmup, segments, benchmarks B2/B4, b2_510300
inherits_from.note: inheritance by pinned hash instead of copying the 1,168-code array; any edit to the R7 config breaks the pin and the run refuses to start

warmup.use: indicator lookback only (max 200 sessions for SMA200/rolling peak); no signals, no metrics

segments.isolation: single continuous simulation per config; segment metrics sliced from one equity curve; boundary mark-to-market carry; test slice evaluated once and only for val-passing configs
segments.history_note: dev consumed by P2-R6 AND P2-R7 (second reuse); val/test never used in any decision, but values exist in archived continuous simulations

signal.selection_freq: monthly (last trading session of each calendar month; inherited R7 rebalance_days verbatim)
signal.momentum: inherited R7: R_k over k in W, equal-weight mean of cross-sectional percentile ranks, ties by ts_code ascending
signal.signal_execution: selection signal at close of monthly rebalance day t; fills at t+1 open; risk state computed at EVERY session close t, traded at t+1 open ONLY on state change

configs_grid.common: W=W2S, N=3, e_on=0.90 (saturates to 25%/leg = 75% effective for N=3; written 0.90 to align B1(m) with R7 TREND)

FIX75.note: control anchor; zero risk trades; MUST reproduce R7 C01 equity curve bit-exact

T200.rule: 000300.SH close > SMA200(close, 200 index sessions incl. t) at session t -> e_on else e_low

T20c2.rule: close > SMA20 on 2 consecutive sessions (t-1 and t) -> e_on else e_low (fast-out slow-in: one day below exits, two days above re-enters)

D252.rule: close >= rolling 252-session peak x (1 - dd_threshold) -> e_on else e_low (rolling peak over index sessions ending t inclusive)

D60.rule: same as D252 over 60 sessions with dd_threshold 0.08

PDD.rule: own-instance total equity (marked at session t close) >= running peak x (1 - dd_threshold) -> e_on else e_low; running peak resets never (all-time within simulation); path-dependent per instance (strategy / B1(m) / B3prime each use their own equity)
PDD.fallback: first sessions before any drawdown computable -> e_on

X1.rule: risk-off (e_low) if T200 condition fires OR D252(0.10) condition fires; else e_on

exposure_mechanisms_daily.warmup_guarantee: 2015 warmup provides >=200 index sessions before first 2016 session; SMA/peak windows fully formed at first judged session

risk_overlay_execution.state_change_only: trade only when E_t != E_{t-1}; equal states -> no risk trades (incumbent weight drift preserved)
risk_overlay_execution.retarget: on the session after a state change, re-target ALL held legs to min(E_t/3, 0.25) x equity(t close); members unchanged, proportional scale; sells and buys at that session's open
risk_overlay_execution.monthly_collision: if a monthly rebalance and a risk state change coincide, compute ONE combined target (member updates x current E_t budget) and execute once at t+1 open
risk_overlay_execution.postpone: a re-sizing leg with no quote at t+1 (suspended) or open beyond +/-9.5% vs pre_close -> postpone to next tradable session open; if the target changes again while postponed, the LATEST target applies at the next tradable open; monthly slot_busy rule unchanged
risk_overlay_execution.turnover_counting: risk re-sizing buys count toward gate-5 buy notional; no exemption
risk_overlay_execution.cash_discipline: single cash pool never negative; buys additionally capped by cash available after same-session sells; capped budget <= commission_min -> skip leg (rule-compliant cash slot)

benchmarks.B1m_matched: same eligible pool, equal weight, same monthly signal days, SAME mechanism DAILY exposure path (own-instance equity peak for PDD); per-leg = min(exposure_t/N_pool, 0.25) x base equity; idle cash carries forward (R7 fixed engine); gross AND net disclosed, net primary
benchmarks.B1_at_100: identical engine with exposure = 1.0 (reference; MUST reproduce R7 B1@100% dev +10.40% / +63.9% / -27.47%)
benchmarks.B3prime: random Top-3 through the same R8 engine, same mechanism exposure semantics (own-instance for PDD), seeds 17..36

dev_all_required.2_excess_vs_B1m: dev net CAGR - B1(m) dev net CAGR >= +0.020 (annualized, pp)
dev_all_required.3_positive_years: net excess vs B1(m) > 0 in >= 4 of 5 dev calendar years
dev_all_required.4_drawdown: dev max drawdown <= 0.20 AND <= B1(m) dev max drawdown
dev_all_required.5_turnover: annual one-side (buy notional / mean equity) max over dev years <= 12.0; monthly sub-cap <= 6.0 (selection is monthly; risk overlay buys count, no exemption)
dev_all_required.6_concentration: dev net profit top-1 code share <= 40% AND top-3 <= 70%
dev_all_required.7_vs_random: dev net CAGR >= mean(B3prime 20 seeds, same mechanism, dev net CAGR) + 0.010 (limited power, noted)
dev_all_required.8_execution: dev-window leg-level execution rate >= 0.95 (planned legs on dev signal days AND dev risk-state-change days; executed = filled / backfilled / rule-compliant cash slot incl. cash-capped / postponed-then-filled)

validation: val net CAGR excess vs B1(m) >= +0.010
net excess vs B1(m) > 0 in both 2021 and 2022
val max drawdown <= 0.20; turnover and concentration <= same dev-gate limits
gates.test_rule: test net excess vs B1(m) >= 0 AND test max drawdown <= 0.20 => P3 candidate; test run once, terminal
gates.advancement: all 12 judged on dev (second-reuse exploratory); among dev all-pass only the highest dev net excess vs B1(m) advances (tie: lower config id); at most 1 survivor; no all-pass -> record and close the direction (sub-monthly risk control incl. weekly), no re-grading, no criterion edits
anchor_regressions_required_before_consu: C01 equity curve bit-exact vs run 20260918T004441-p2r7-etf-exposure-d01f4e7a C01
gates.trial_count_note: cumulative trials: 115 (27 stock + 20 factor survey + 44 window diagnostic + 12 P2-R6 + 12 P2-R7) + 12 here = 127

preanalysis_sect0.scope: index-only (000300.SH from the pinned batch), computed and archived BEFORE any strategy run output; fixed definitions, not tunable
preanalysis_sect0.per_mechanism_dev_stats: trigger count 2016-2020, risk-off session share, index decline already suffered from local peak at each trigger (p50/p90/max)
preanalysis_sect0.purpose: ex-ante disclosure of the daily-check ceiling (e.g. D252-10 fires after >=10% index drawdown x ~1.6 crash beta x 75% on-exposure ~ -12% starting point, plus overnight gaps and residual low-tier exposure); expectation management, NOT a gate; no config may be added/removed based on it
